sections.title: Foundational courses
sections.copy: Calculus: [(MATH 1013 or MATH 1023) and (MATH 1014 or MATH 1024)] or MATH 1020. Choose one Physics I and one Physics II course.

sections.title: CPEG core
sections.copy: Complete the standard C++ sequence or COMP 2012H; choose one organization course and one discrete mathematics course. Complete CPEG 1971 with a project/thesis, or CPEG 4910. Students taking the Research Option must take CPEG 4902 or CPEG 4912.
